items.title: Reliable Renaming
items.description: Rename a list as many times in a row as you like: the pager updates in place, no error popups, and home-screen widgets keep working across renames.

items.title: Show/Hide at a Glance
items.description: A dedicated eye toggle in every list's top bar replaces the menu entry - and the Settings switch, which is gone now.

items.title: Smoother Editor
items.description: The keyboard's check button saves the sheet from every field, and the due-date field is simply labeled Date.

items.title: Focused Folder View
items.description: No more swiping between folders in the folder view: the position badge is gone, and a list created in an empty folder opens right away.

items.title: Menu Icons Everywhere
items.description: Folder and section menus now carry matching icons for rename, move, delete, and more.

items.title: Folder Widgets
items.description: Widgets can now be bound to a whole folder: the header shows the folder name and its lists appear one after another with small headers, in your manual order.

items.title: Context-Aware Add Button
items.description: The widget's add button follows its binding - a folder widget opens the picker scoped to that folder's lists, and the full picker mirrors the folder structure.

items.title: Recolored, Centered Icon
items.description: The launcher icon is now red on black, with the logo optically centered.

items.title: Todoist-Style Priorities
items.description: Priorities are now P1 (red), P2 (yellow), P3 (blue) and P4 (default), consistent in light and dark themes.

items.title: Notes and a Cleaner Editor
items.description: Each task can carry a one-line note, with links clickable from the list. The editor is decluttered: no start/scheduled/done fields (the completion date still shows on completed tasks) and no recurrence field.

items.title: Long-Press Actions
items.description: Move and Delete now live behind a long press on a todo - no more swipes fighting with list paging. Moving or copying shows the folder structure instead of a flat list.

items.title: Smoother Deletion
items.description: Deleting a list now takes you back to the folder view, whether or not other lists remain.

items.title: Folders
items.description: Organize your lists into folders with emoji badges and colors, alongside the unfiled lists at the top level.

items.title: Manual Ordering
items.description: Drag and drop to arrange folders and lists in any order; your custom order is kept across restarts and syncs.

items.title: Folder-Aware Widgets
items.description: The widget picker mirrors the folder structure, task rows show their priority, and widgets no longer repeat the list name under every entry.

items.title: Open Folders Faster
items.description: Tapping a folder now opens its first list directly — a fixed folder bar on top with the folder menu, and each list's own bar swiping underneath. The folder view remains available through Reorder lists, where new lists can be created too.

items.title: Show or Hide Completed
items.description: A quick toggle in every list's menu shows or hides completed tasks without leaving the screen.

items.title: Polished Details
items.description: New entries start with a capital letter, and the list pager lets you swipe between the lists of a folder.

items.title: Merged Upstream Updates
items.description: Synced with upstream: safer note links opened from external intents and widgets, plus updated libraries.

items.title: Fresh Expressive Look
items.description: Settings is now organized into grouped cards with a large title that collapses as you scroll, and dependent options animate in when you enable them.

items.title: Friendly Empty States
items.description: Home, category, daily focus, and the add-task picker now show illustrated placeholders instead of plain text.

items.title: Smoother Motion
items.description: The app now uses the Material 3 Expressive motion scheme for more natural, consistent animations throughout.

items.title: Redesigned Onboarding
items.description: A clearer first-run experience with an animated hero and a more prominent folder picker.

items.title: Better Widgets
items.description: Choose which list a widget shows, hide completed tasks, and see it update the moment your todos change.

items.title: Polished Navigation
items.description: Back gestures now play a smooth slide transition, and the home and note screens refresh when you return to the app.

items.title: Rendering Freeze Fix
items.description: Fixed a rare freeze caused by the floating action button's shadow.

items.title: Safer Note Links
items.description: Notes opened from external intents and widgets are now validated to keep your files safe.

items.title: Updated Foundation
items.description: Updated Gradle, Android Gradle Plugin, Kotlin, Compose BOM, and AndroidX libraries.
